CustomField.description: A Form Submission used as this section's starting values. Repeater and Table sections seed their default rows from it, and Field Set sections preview with it. Lets a section start with default rows or values without a prefill flow.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pick a Form Submission record whose values pre-fill new repeater or table rows in this section. Use it to seed defaults without writing a prefill Flow; leave blank for empty rows.
CustomField.label: Pre-fill Template
